title: GCC simulation and analysis code
description: Software archive for the Gamma-Code Consensus (GCC) project. Version v2.0.1-noc-preflight is the Paperpal/OUP preflight-clean Neuroscience of Consciousness submission snapshot. It adds the shortened technical-compliance manuscript while retaining the final author-generated validation package covering synthetic regime simulations, Chennu and DS005620 propofol EEG analyses, Sleep-EDF state geometry, Mendeley disorders-of-consciousness pilot analyses, ketamine boundary-state analyses, DS004504 degradation-proxy analyses, spectral residualization, gamma-artifact controls, phase-surrogate controls, wPLI controls, amplitude-normalized phase-only analyses, CSD/source-proxy analyses, reliability checks, derived result tables, and figure-generation scripts. Raw third-party datasets are not redistributed.
